propositions: REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable is read by OpcertServiceConfig.from_env but never removed from os.environ, leaving the inline PEM readable in process environment dumps and inherited by child processes like ssh-keygen and git
os.environ.pop should be called on REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY in _private_key_env after capturing the value, implementing consume-once semantics at the single env boundary
Calling from_env twice in the same process must yield private_key=None on the second call, pinning a consume-once contract to prevent silent regression if a reload path is added later
The pop must occur after the value is captured and before from_env returns, so that compose_signer still receives the key through cfg.private_key but the env variable is absent for child processes
The fix must not affect REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or other environment variables, which should remain in os.environ
The env registry generator scripts/gen_env_registry.py requires os.environ.get to remain with a literal key name for detection, so the pop must be a separate statement after the get
